description: Use when the author asks to change the date or time of one pending publication. Supply its publicationId and a concrete ISO date with UTC offset. Does not change its content.

publicationId.description: One delivery/job id from list_publications; distinct from the source postId.

scheduledAt.description: Exact publication time as ISO 8601 with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-29T10:00:00+07:00. Resolve the user time zone before scheduling.

name: reschedule_publication
title: Move a scheduled publication
